description: This is a Linux kernel driver source file for the PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) network interface, specifically for VR9 hardware. It includes core functions for initializing, configuring, and managing the PTM device, handling network operations, interrupts, and firmware versioning.

methods.name: ptm_showtime_enter
methods.description: Enables showtime mode, sets carrier on, configures hardware registers, and logs entry.

methods.name: ptm_showtime_exit
methods.description: Disables showtime mode, sets carrier off, and resets hardware state.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver, allocates network devices, registers IRQs, and starts the hardware.

methods.name: ltq_ptm_remove
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters devices, and stops the hardware.

methods.name: ptm_setup
methods.description: Configures network device parameters and MAC address.

methods.name: ptm_get_stats
methods.description: Returns network statistics for the device.

methods.name: ptm_open
methods.description: Starts network interface, enables NAPI, and enables interrupts.

methods.name: ptm_stop
methods.description: Stops network interface, disables NAPI, and disables interrupts.

methods.name: ptm_poll
methods.description: Processes received packets from descriptors, handles buffer management.

methods.name: ptm_napi_poll
methods.description: NAPI poll function, calls ptm_poll and manages interrupt masking.

methods.name: ptm_hard_start_xmit
methods.description: Transmits a packet by preparing descriptors and updating hardware.

methods.name: ptm_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for statistics, configuration, and priority mapping.

methods.name: ptm_tx_timeout
methods.description: Handles transmission timeout, disables TX interrupt, and wakes queue.

methods.name: alloc_skb_rx
methods.description: Allocates receive buffer skb with proper alignment.

methods.name: alloc_skb_tx
methods.description: Allocates transmit buffer skb with proper alignment.

methods.name: get_skb_pointer
methods.description: Retrieves skb pointer from dataptr, with validation.

methods.name: get_tx_desc
methods.description: Gets available transmit descriptor, updates descriptor index.

methods.name: mailbox_irq_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for mailbox, schedules NAPI and tasklets.

methods.name: do_swap_desc_tasklet
methods.description: Handles swap descriptors, replenishes buffers, and manages interrupt masks.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_version
methods.description: Retrieves and formats firmware version info.

methods.name: init_priv_data
methods.description: Initializes private data, configures QoS, descriptors, and hardware registers.

methods.name: clear_priv_data
methods.description: Clears private data (empty implementation).

methods.name: init_tables
methods.description: Initializes descriptor tables, buffers, and hardware configuration.

methods.name: clear_tables
methods.description: Frees buffers and clears descriptor tables.
